cc:Work.dc:title: KD mutex storage and registry comparison
cc:Work.dc:description: Input comparison.json SHA256: 817f8a2df9766130b4099a6516b975bf6265c73eb4c570a6789c5c9811862d6b. 63/63 eligible plain sessions; three planned repeats per version/workload/worker group. Median whole-interval Mops/s with observed min-max ranges, not confidence intervals. Source versions ran sequentially, not randomized. Profile sessions are excluded. Mixed execution classes have no pooled point; lines stop at execution-class changes or missing data.
